records.title: 1517年：Ajeeva在Li Btei传播Praxis
records.description: Li Btei理念明确Ajeeva于1517到来，以团结和反种姓演讲传播Guru Suhan教导。这里记地方宗教传播，不主张Li Btei同时脱离Bhuvauri独立。 此为已封存MOD理念的有年叙述，证据等级保持单一游戏文本；不自动修改政权、疆界或宗属。

dateEvidence.precision: explicit year in MOD narrative / diegetic quotation
dateEvidence.quote: At a crossroads on the Kharunyanan River, the people of Li Btei are a melting pot of Chengrong, Rasarhid, Sarniryabsad, Bom, and Harimari culture. Where others might segregate, Li Btei tears down barriers and embraces this melting pot. Their crucible of divergent beliefs is a source of pride to the people of Li Btei. You can find Raheni, Bom, and Harimari individuals working side by side as administrators, diplomats, officers, and soldiers.\n\nLi Btei's open-minded and egalitarian cultural leanings proved to be an unlit match that was waiting for its spark. With the arrival of Ajeeva in 1517, and her speeches of unity and her words of anti-caste rhetoric, the teachings of Guru Suhan spread through the land like wildfire, quickly turning Li Btei into a veritable hotbed of Praxis theology in Rahen.
dateEvidence.scope: context only, not inferred from unlock date

records.title: 1548年：Ajeeva在Sramaya去世
records.description: Ajeeva固定传记在Later Theological Work And Legacy末段记其于1548在Sramaya因年老去世。其著作、学生及与三家的紧张合作持续影响Bhuvauri改革，但不提供正式废奴年，也不能将宗教废奴理想等同国家已经废除学院奴役。与旧1517 Li Btei传播断言共用同一人物履历。
